title: Production incident triage

items.short: Onset 13:32 UTC tied to BST flag flip
Rules out 4483 with evidence; no revert
Discount major units vs minor-unit ints
Stuck confirming carts cause 409s; scoped reset after flag-off
Flag off first, before code fix
Declines restart and FLUSHDB with reason
Named signal and timing after flag revert
Fix converts discount; rejects int coercion

design_notes: The traceback and the discount=5.00 next to subtotal=4299 make the mechanism (N4) findable on inspection, so bare runs score there; the headroom is in what happens around it. Bare runs typically date onset to the alert or the last deploy and read the flag audit's 14:32 BST as a post-alert event, so they blame build 4478's rollout or 4483 instead of the flag flip (N1, N3); they list the redis reconnects as something to also look at rather than baselining them against the pre-onset rate (N6); they accept a pod restart as harmless alongside the flag revert (N8); they say 'monitor error rates' with no signal, value, or time that allows for the 30 s flag poll (N9); and they stop at the 500s without following one failing cart to its 409 retry, so the carts left in 'confirming' and their scoped reset are missed (N5).
